name: Freshdesk → DevRev migration POC
description: Stand up a parallel-run DevRev environment seeded with KB articles, sample tickets, and the parts/SLA scaffolding a Freshdesk customer expects. Drop your Freshdesk export CSVs in `csv` to import real tickets/contacts; the agent auto-detects Freshdesk headers.

ui_guidance.title: Map Freshdesk priorities to DevRev
steps: Verify the mapping in your CSV column_map (use 'priority_name' → 'priority' if you exported from Freshdesk's default columns).

ui_guidance.title: SLA policy parity with Freshdesk
steps: Recreate your Freshdesk SLA bands by severity: First-response and Resolution targets per priority.
Apply per-account using the same Enterprise/Standard split you used in Freshdesk.

ui_guidance.title: Bidirectional Freshdesk Airsync (parallel-run period)
steps: Authenticate against your Freshdesk subdomain (read-only API key recommended for parallel-run)
Map Freshdesk Products → DevRev Parts (use the parts hierarchy seeded above as the target)
Enable bidirectional ticket sync until you cut over
Disable sync after cutover and import the final delta CSV

ui_guidance.title: Importing your real Freshdesk export
steps: Export tickets from Freshdesk → Admin → Account → Data Exports.
Drop the CSV next to this blueprint and add a `csv` entry: `{ "path": "./fd-tickets.csv", "entity": "tickets" }`.
The agent auto-detects Freshdesk headers (Ticket ID, Requester Name, Agent Name, Priority Name, Status Name) and applies the column map automatically.
Override mappings via `column_map` if your export has custom columns.
